item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine has intensified drone strikes on the Kerch bridge, causing a partial collapse, while Russia has pledged to rebuild the structure stronger. Russian forces have continued attacks in Odesa, killing four civilians, and a Russian strike killed a Ukrainian mother, an athlete and a drone operator. Russian officials warned an EU delegation would not be forced to join Ukraine talks, contrasting with Moscow's reconstruction pledge. The conflict still generates high casualties, with 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Sanctions have been imposed on eight Israeli construction firms for building West West Bank settlements, aiming to support a two-state solution. An Israeli airstrike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital killed a doctor and a child, and later killed three Hamas militants, including an Oct. 7 attacker. Israeli settlers shot a Palestinian woman near Jericho, and a car-ramming incident involving settlers was judged not a terror attack. The Erez Crossing opened for inspection of Gaza aid trucks for the first time since February 2025, and the government froze the controversial E1 settlement tender process pending a new administration. 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel and Hezbollah: the situation
item.description:
Israel’s forces have recently destroyed an underground Hezbollah infrastructure in south Lebanon and a Hezbollah tunnel in Shebaa, while also launching operations in central Gaza and a Hamas-controlled area of Gaza. Iraq has moved its army into a stronghold of the Iran-backed Kataib Hezbollah, linking the regional fight to the Israel-Hezbollah clash. Hezbollah and Iran have recruited Thai clerics for a foiled plot to attack the Israeli embassy in Bangkok, and Israeli officials have threatened to seize more territory in Gaza, Lebanon and Syria. The World Bank notes Lebanon’s reconstruction is proceeding slowly, and the UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024.

item.title: Yemen and the Red Sea: the situation
item.description:
Houthis have seized the Bab al-Mandeb strait and surrounding positions after Yemeni government forces withdrew, securing the key maritime chokepoint and moving within about 60 km of Aden. Saudi Arabia dismissed its coalition commander as anti-Houthi forces pulled back from the strait and other key areas. The Yemeni parliament approved a law designating the Houthis as terrorists, raising concerns of a resurgence by southern separatists. Saudi-backed forces in Yemen have stepped up attacks on Houthi positions, while the coalition has hit dozens of Houthi military sites. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: South Sudan: the situation
item.description:
Drone strikes are now a major source of fatalities, with Sudan drones responsible for nearly three quarters of war deaths this year and South Sudan accusing Sudan of a drone attack that killed scores in a disputed area. A priest who had fled South Sudan was murdered in Birmingham, and a pastor was jailed in South Sudan for performing a Christian song with musical instruments. The government screened out 54 children from a police recruitment drive, and SPLM Jonglei chairperson candidates began their race without primaries in Pigi County, while a chairperson was injured in a road incident. Protesters demanded inclusion in the UNISFA mandate drafting, and UCDP recorded two battle-related deaths in 2024.

item.title: Ethiopia: the situation
item.description:
Federal forces are advancing in Tigray while militia attacks near the Ethiopia-Kenya border have killed civilians and displaced thousands, raising the refugee count in Kenya above 50,000. Eritrean forces have carried out drone and artillery strikes near Badme and Ethiopian drones are operating over Sudan, with RSF drones launching from Ethiopian territory against Sudanese targets, prompting diplomatic expulsions and consular closures. Heavy weapon clashes have spread on the Oromia-Somali border to Mieso and Afdem, and fighting in Moyale deepens a territorial dispute. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: The Sahel insurgency: the situation
item.description:
US intelligence support is now being used to target militants in Nigeria ahead of the 2027 election, and President Tinubu says four of eight identified top terrorist leaders have been killed or arrested. The Nigerian army reports eight terrorists killed and the rescue of 125 kidnapping victims, while bandits killed two abducted victims in Niger State despite a six-million-naira ransom. Mali has received Mi-24 and Mi-8 helicopters and an Il-76 transport, and 300 Russian mercenaries, likely Wagner and Africa Corps, were killed there. A Protestant missionary abducted by militants was released in Niger and thousands of Arab nomads were ordered to leave southeast Niger. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Political figures are being targeted, with a police arrest of 78 Muslim youths over an attack on President Tinubu and a question from Obi about repeated killings in Plateau. The House of Representatives condemned the armed closure of Zintan Airport that stalled a parliamentary session, and the UN welcomed new laws criminalising the conscription of minors and raising the recruitment age to 18. item.title: Myanmar's civil war: the situation
item.description:
The junta has destroyed bridges in Arakan, moved west of the Sittaung River and plans a 108‑kilometre fence on the Bangladesh border while airstrikes hit a displacement camp in Rakhine. In Sagaing, junta forces killed 11 people as Starlink outages isolated communities and health-care facilities kept being attacked in October 2026. Gold revenues now fund resistance groups and Myanmar-linked arsenic pollution is driving a clean-water scramble in Thailand. The top UN court will rule on Myanmar’s alleged genocide against the Rohingya, a verdict watched for Gaza implications, and Rohingya refugees pin hopes on it; 2,332 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
